name: JW Marriott Khao Lak Resort & Spa
positioning: Beachfront resort on Khuk Khak Beach in Khao Lak with a lagoon pool winding through the grounds, a working farm and a bamboo shark nursery
best_for: Families who want pool access rooms, a water play zone and a kids club
Couples who want a beachfront villa with a private pool and butler

facts.text: The resort sits on the golden sands of Khuk Khak Beach in Phang Nga, overlooking the Andaman Sea.
The setting combines sea, sand and tropical greenery with granite mountains and nearby waterfalls.
Modern architecture is blended with Thai touches such as curved multitiered roofs.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary Thai-style furnishings with authentic local fabrics.
Guest rooms have deep terrazzo bathtubs and generous balconies or terraces.
Quan Spa offers signature massages and an Andaman rejuvenation body wrap.
The Aqua Play Zone has water slides, a wave pool, a fountain trampoline and a children's playground.
The Family by JW Club offers gardening and cooking workshops connected to the JW Garden, jungle-themed play zones and craft studios.
Stand-up paddle boards, sea kayaks and boogie boards are available from the Watersports Hut on Khuk Khak Beach.
The resort's location offers diving and snorkeling at the Similan and Surin Islands.
A Phang Nga cacao pod-to-bar experience at the resort's Chocolate Atelier was created with Duc de Praslin.
Olive serves authentic Italian classics with a curated selection of mono-cultivar olive oils.

highlights.text: Signature Pool Access rooms have a terrace with direct access to the lagoon pool, which the resort calls Southeast Asia's longest.
A Coconut Boat cruises the lagoon pool each day, serving fresh coconuts to guests.
The JW Garden is a working farm that grows over 200 varieties of plants, fruits, vegetables, leaves and herbs for the resort, and is home to two water buffalo, goats, chickens and ducks.
Guests can join the Bamboo Shark Nursery & Conservation Center to help breed and nurture bamboo sharks, and can release baby bamboo sharks back into the wild.
The beachfront villas have private pools, ocean views and separate living, sleeping and dining quarters, with a personal villa butler on hand around the clock.

considerations.text: Phuket International Airport is about 83 km from the hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires travel time to reach local attractions.
